#### CEVA Logistics opens new distribution facility in Derby to support eCommerce growth 

- Date : July 18 2026, 7:16 pm 
- Author : Logistics Monitor 

CEVA Logistics, a global leader in third-party logistics, has announced the opening of a new large-scale warehouse operation in Derby, UK, marking another significant milestone for the company and further strengthening its position as a strategic logistics partner for leading global eCommerce brands.

The new operation, scheduled to go live in August 2026, will see CEVA manage a dedicated facility designed to support the rapid deployment of fast-moving inventory for fulfilment to end-customers across the UK.

Supporting regional eCommerce Growth 

CEVA will operate the new 508,000-square-foot warehouse facility in Derby to manage the storage, handling and distribution of customer inventory, enabling faster, more efficient customer deliveries across the UK. # VB Distribution opens new Lancashire warehouse complex 

 Jordan Taylor July 24, 2026

Darwen, Lancashire Jul 24, 2026 (EMWNews.com) – VB Distribution has opened its new business park in Lancashire, adding 100,000 sq. ft of bonded warehousing and trade counter capacity to its national network of depots, now totalling 500,000 sq. ft across the country. # Translink Express makes four senior appointments

Leicestershire logistics firm Translink Express Logistics has made four senior appointments following 32 per cent growth over the past two years.

Lee Barrett has been promoted to head of traffic; Dan Green takes the newly created role of head of project management; and Shanice Walsh becomes head of operations.

Ryan Wallis has also joined the family-owned business as head of warehousing.

The new management team will take responsibility for the day-to-day running of Translink Express, allowing its directors to focus more closely on long-term strategy as the business approaches its 40th anniversary.

# Lancashire vape wholesaler opens new Darwen business park

 By Safiyyah Tayyeb Community Reporter 

 3 

 

 

 

 A leading UK vape wholesaler has opened a major new business park in Darwen. 

 VB Distribution has added 100,000 square feet of warehousing and trade counter space as part of its continued national expansion. 

 The new Lancashire site brings its total national depot network to 500,000 square feet and strengthens its position ahead of major changes to the vaping industry later this year. 

 The business park expands the company’s customs-bonded warehouse operation, allowing products to be stored without duty being paid until they leave the warehouse.

In Your Area Ian Bunting

22:50, 14 Aug 2026

View Image

Route2 owner Joe Wall and operations manager Rodger Caldwell

Route2 Logistics has officially opened its new depot in Coatbridge, marking a major milestone in the continued growth of the specialist haulage and pallet distribution business.

Located at 8 Palacecraig Street, nestled between the M8 and M73, the new 22,000-sq ft facility provides additional warehousing, yard space and vehicle capacity, creating a significant new operational base for Route2 in the West of Scotland.

The Coatbridge depot complements Route2’s established Dunfermline operation, creating a stronger Scotland-based network and enabling the business to provide faster lead times, greater capacity and flexibility for companies delivering products to customers across Scotland.

Published 18th Aug 2026, 16:31 BST Updated 18th Aug 2026, 16:55 BST

## Planning permission was granted for a proposed new £18m DHL premises at Ballyearl Business Park at Antrim and Newtownabbey Borough Council’s Planning Committee on Monday.

The proposal is for the erection of a storage and distribution warehouse building with ancillary facilities, office space, internal chiller unit, solar panels and external yard, including HGV and car parking, landscaping and infrastructure works.

Access is proposed from an established entrance into Ballyearl Business Park at Houston’s Corner, Newtownabbey.

A planning officer told the meeting it was considered the proposal would represent a “significant contribution to the regional economy”.
